method_verbatim.value: After confirmation, complete deflation of the balloon was performed with a negative pressure of -20cmH2O using a 10mL syringe. Thereupon, we inflated the balloon with 10mL of air and removed 6.5mL, the remaining 3.5mL in the catheter. This is the mean value of balloon air volume shown in the literature to be best associated with the appropriate ratio of esophageal pressure to airway pressure (DPes/DPaw) value between 0.8 and 1.2, which indicates the balloon is appropriately located, providing a valid measurement of Pes. The ratio was measured through a maneuver with 3 to 5 manual chest wall compressions, with the patient sedated in an expiratory pause.

position_verification.value: The catheter was advanced 60cm from the anterior incisors into the stomach, at which point the balloon was inflated with 0.5mL of air. subgroup_flags.classification_notes: ards_subgroup: all 49 patients had ARDS (Berlin criteria), pulmonary origin, confirmed by 'Pulmonary ARDS - 49/49 (100)'. obesity_subgroup: enrolment did not require obesity and BMI is not reported, but obesity was present in 11/49 (22%) as a comorbidity, so the population is mixed by BMI; the mean/median BMI is unavailable and mean BMI is therefore not known to be >= 30 kg/m2. timing_subgroup: PEEP titration with the assigned method started immediately after randomization, and randomisation required ARDS criteria for less than 36 hours, so balloon-guided management started within 48 h of ARDS onset. ptp_target_subgroups: only the esophageal-catheter strategy used a transpulmonary-pressure target (end-expiratory PL > 0 and <= 2 cmH2O, absolute Pes subtraction); the EIT, best-compliance and PEEP/FiO2-table strategies used non-Ptp targets and therefore contribute no additional Ptp target subgroup. Longest reported mortality: only 28-day mortality is reported; it is the longest available follow-up (no 60-day, 90-day or hospital/ICU mortality is reported), so it is flagged is_longest_reported_mortality.

extraction_flags.overlap_evidence: Checked registration, enrolment window and centre against every cluster in studies/COHORTS.md. Registration: REBEC RBR-9b7jbxm - does not appear in any other candidate report and matches no cluster (epvent1 = NCT00127491; epvent2 = NCT02040103/EPVent-2; mannheim_boesing = DRKS00017449/DRKS00013967; mgh_lung_rescue = NCT02105220, NCT02503241). Enrolment: April 2018 to May 2021 at a single ten-bed respiratory ICU in Florianópolis (SC), Brazil - no other candidate report enrols in Brazil or over this window. Eligibility is also discordant with the clusters: this study requires ARDS (Berlin) with PaO2/FiO2 <= 300, whereas pirrone_2016 excludes ARDS and florio_2020 requires ARDS with BMI > 40. The paper notes that some of its COVID-19 ARDS patients may have been reported elsewhere (10 COVID-ARDS patients from the Angers cohort were published in another paper not present in this folder), but no Angers report is in this pool and the Angers cluster was settled as non-overlapping (DECISIONS C23). Conclusion: unique cohort, no overlap; no cohort_id assigned.

extraction_flags.general_notes: Hybrid design: parallel-arm randomised comparison (primary outcome and clinical outcomes) plus a within-patient comparison of four PEEP titration methods applied to every patient at Day 0 (Table 3S, Section 8S, Figures 4-5). Only the esophageal-catheter arm is the intervention of interest for this review; EIT and best compliance are alternative titration conditions and the low PEEP/FiO2 table is the comparator. Additional Table 2 coefficients not entered as effect estimates: baseline compliance 1.05 mL/cmH2O (95%CI 0.93-1.16; p < 0.01) in Table 2, and in the interaction model (Table 5S) baseline compliance 1.04 (0.92-1.16; p < 0.01) and day (numeric) -1.29 (-2.49 to -0.09; p = 0.04). No subgroup analyses were performed ('The small sample size did not allow us to perform subgroup analysis'). The trial was stopped early for slow recruitment and limited funding (49 of a planned 60 patients), which is important for interpretation of the null result. Correlation and Bland-Altman analyses (Section 8S, Figures 4, 5, 7S, 8S) have no dedicated schema fields; the Bland-Altman mean differences and their limits of agreement were recorded as paired_effects with the limits of agreement described in 'derivation'. The paper states that balloon volume was not titrated after prone positioning and that adequacy of the 0 to +2 cmH2O end-expiratory target in prone position is uncertain, but that catheter position was verified daily.
